item.title: MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 Reveals Full Nominee List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news from the music world. Today, we're talking about the MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026. Japan's biggest international music awards show has just unveiled its nominees across 63 categories, and we're excited to share the details with you."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN, or MAJ, is all about 'Connecting with the world, illuminating the future of music.' This year's ceremony will feature 77 categories, spanning genres and national borders. The nominees were selected through a preliminary vote by 5,000 music industry professionals from Japan and around the world."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Some of the notable nominees include HANA, Kenshi Yonezu, Sakanaction, and Fujii Kaze, among many others. The nominations cover a wide range of categories, from Song of the Year to Best Dance & Vocal Song, and even Best Digital Culture Artist."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The MAJ Ambassadors, Kento Nakajima and Mei Hata, recently shared their thoughts on the nominations. Nakajima is excited about the Best J-POP Song Award, while Hata is looking forward to the Best K-POP Song Award. Both ambassadors believe that Japanese music has a unique charm that can reach audiences worldwide."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The final voting to determine the winners will take place from April 30 to May 20, conducted by music industry professionals. The winners will be announced at the awards ceremony on June 13 at TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO and SGC Hall Ariake. You can catch the Grand Ceremony live on NHK, the red carpet event on NHK BS, and the Premiere Ceremony covering all other categories."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time with more updates from the music world!"
